metadata.title: Urban Luxury Portrait with Iced-Out Jewelry

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, close-up studio portrait of a male figure with a focused gaze, framed by hands displaying large, diamond-encrusted letter rings. The subject wears a neutral-toned puffer jacket, a Union Jack beanie, and a massive rose gold Cuban link chain with a sculptural bust pendant. The lighting is sharp, emphasizing the metallic sheen of the jewelry and the texture of the skin and fabric against a dark, vignetted background.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the left and right hands framing the face
Contrast between the soft fabric of the puffer jacket and the hard, reflective jewelry
Color harmony between the rose gold metal and the warm skin tones
Visual weight centered on the large sculptural pendant
coreInvariants: Rose gold metallic finish on all jewelry
High-density diamond pavé setting on rings
Neutral, desaturated background to make the subject pop
Sharp focus on the eyes and the jewelry details

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, tight head-and-shoulders crop with hands raised to eye level.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large rose gold sculptural pendant at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves outward to the lettered rings on the fingers, then down the chain to the central pendant.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark gray vignetted space at the top corners providing breathing room for the hood.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and beige (puffer jacket) providing a neutral base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rose gold and diamond white (jewelry) providing the primary visual interest.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the clothing and background allows the warm, high-value rose gold and the red/blue of the beanie to stand out.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a muted, earthy base palette

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are scaled to fit the width of individual fingers
Heavy beveling on the edges of the letter faces

composition.position: Across the knuckles of both hands
composition.rotation: Follows the angle of the hands
composition.warp: Perspective shift based on finger orientation

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The 3D jewelry type acts as the primary graphic element, paired with the sculptural pendant for a cohesive 'luxury hardware' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy blocky skeleton needed for the 3D extrusion.
The letters must appear as physical objects with light interaction.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a beige puffer jacket and Union Jack beanie, hands raised to his face, wearing a large rose gold Cuban link chain with a sculptural bust pendant. Use high-contrast lighting and a dark gray background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Model 3D block letters with a rose gold finish and diamond pavé faces. Place one letter on each knuckle to spell out the desired words, ensuring they follow the perspective and lighting of the hands.

verificationChecks: Do the rings have realistic 3D depth?
Is the rose gold color consistent across all jewelry?
Does the lighting on the letters match the studio lighting on the face?
Is the Union Jack pattern on the beanie correctly oriented?

adjustableVariables: Specific design of the central pendant
mustRedesign: Exact likeness of the sculptural pendant
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hands look natural while holding the chain
Verify the 3D letters don't look like 2D stickers
Confirm the background vignette is smooth and not banded
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + [Subject Description] + [Clothing Description] + Symmetrical hand pose with [Custom 3D Iced-Out Letter Rings] + Large [Rose Gold Chain and Pendant] + High-contrast lighting + Dark vignetted background.
